title: Diagram Checklist: Draw Each One Twice Before the Exam
subject: Science

blocks.p: Diagrams carry easy marks if the **labels** are right. Draw each one from memory, check the labels against your textbook, and tick the box. Use a pencil, keep label lines straight and parallel, and never let them cross.
